brief: Today is {{TODAY}}. Harness: Claude Code desktop app. The harness reports this session's model as claude-sonnet-5-5 at effort medium.
The session usage tool reports tokensUsed 180,000, contextWindow 1,000,000 and autoCompactsAtPercent 97. This session was compacted once, an hour ago.
A fresh session in this harness and project starts at 86,450 tokens (measured: the usage tool's total less its Messages category).

Next stage: a refactor within one module, with its test suite as the oracle. The module does not touch authentication, payments, storage formats or a public interface. Plan estimate: 45 turns. No per-turn measurement exists.
A fresh session would read 15,000 tokens: the handoff and the module.
A handoff for this stage would be about 80 lines.

If the stage goes to a fresh session, the operator has asked this session to start it, receive its note, run the test suite on its branch and merge it before ending: about 4 turns in all. Otherwise nobody coordinates.
Everything this session knows that the next stage needs is already written in files on disk.
No cache-miss measurement exists, and no review pauses are expected during the stage.
The stage writes files and commits locally; nothing leaves the machine.
